name: Fujita Nagisa
source:
She is a brownish-colored woman who works as a lifesaver.

She is a well-trained swimmer and has a good figure, but she is also a married woman.

She has a strong sense of justice, she finds Kenta and the others acting suspiciously and warns them.

However, Kenta and his friends, who find this annoying, retaliate against her...
